pz.grpStepSub: "Win in N" with few pieces: 1, 2, then 3 moves, slowly reading deeper.
pz.grpTacSub: "Win material in N" from real games: counting the recapture and spotting capture chains.
pz.grpEndSub: Longer hunts: catching the very last pieces with few of your own.
pz.th.count.sub: The biggest capture is not always right
pz.th.chain.sub: Three captures or more in one turn
ls.b_approach.title: Capture by approach
ls.b_approach.intro:
If the point next to your landing point holds an enemy piece, it is captured together with the enemy pieces lined up behind it (approach).
When there are several captures, find the one that takes the most.
ls.b_approach.goal: Play the approach that captures the most.
ls.b_approach.hint: Step the piece in the gold ring towards the enemy line.
ls.b_withdraw.title: Capture by withdrawal
ls.b_withdraw.intro:
Step straight away from an adjacent enemy piece and it is captured with the enemy pieces lined up behind it (withdrawal).
Find the move that takes the most.
ls.b_withdraw.goal: Play the withdrawal that captures the most.
ls.b_withdraw.hint: Move the piece in the gold ring straight away from the enemy line next to it.
ls.b_choose.title: Approach or withdrawal
ls.b_choose.intro:
When one step can capture both by approach and by withdrawal, you take only one of the lines.
Tap a piece in a dashed ring to choose — pick the bigger line.
ls.b_choose.goal: Play the move that captures the most (choose approach or withdrawal).
ls.b_choose.hint: Move the piece in the gold ring and choose the longer line.
ls.b_chain.title: Keep capturing
ls.b_chain.intro:
A capturing piece may capture again in the same turn, changing direction each time and never returning to a point it visited.
Keep going and take as many as you can.
ls.b_chain.goal: Play the move that captures the most in total.
ls.b_chain.hint: Capture with the piece in the gold ring and do not stop — keep taking.
ls.b_chain.ng: Going on would have taken more (answer: {m}).
ls.b_safe.title: A safe move
ls.b_safe.sub: When there is nothing to take
ls.b_safe.intro:
With no capture available you play a non-capturing move (paika).
The key is to give the opponent nothing to capture: after moving, check that no piece of yours stands in line with an enemy piece.
ls.b_safe.goal: Play a move that gives the opponent no capture.
ls.b_safe.hint: The piece in the gold ring can move to a safe point.
ls.b_safe.why: After {m} the opponent can take nothing.
ls.b_safe.ng: After that move the opponent can capture (a safe move: {m}).
ls.b_win.title: Finish the game
ls.b_win.intro:
Capture all the opponent's pieces to win (leaving them unable to move also wins).
Find the move that takes everything.
ls.b_win.hint: Capture with the piece in the gold ring, and keep capturing to the end.
ls.t_big.title: Big captures
ls.t_big.intro: Many captures are possible here. Compare approaches, withdrawals and chains, and choose the best including the shape afterwards.
ls.t_big.hint: The piece in the gold ring is the one to move.
ls.t_count.title: Count the recapture
ls.t_count.sub: Taking the most is not always best
ls.t_count.intro:
The biggest capture is not always the best move.
Count how many the opponent takes back and compare "taken − taken back".
ls.t_count.goal: Count the recapture and choose the best capture.
ls.t_count.hint: The piece in the gold ring is the one to move. Check big captures for a big recapture.
ls.t_stop.title: Stop in time
ls.t_stop.intro:
Going on with a capture chain is optional.
If the opponent would take back a lot where the chain ends, stopping early can be right. To stop, tap the piece again or anywhere else.
ls.t_stop.hint: Capture with the piece in the gold ring and stop where it is safe.
ls.t_paika.title: Choosing a paika
ls.t_paika.intro:
With nothing to capture, which piece you move can change everything.
Find a move that gives the opponent no capture and prepares a capture of your own.
ls.t_paika.goal: What is the best non-capturing move?
ls.t_paika.hint: The piece in the gold ring is the one to move.
ls.e_hunt.title: The hunt
ls.e_hunt.intro:
An endgame with few pieces. Take away the enemy pieces' escape routes and drive them where they can be captured.
Careful: standing in line with an enemy piece can get you captured instead.
ls.e_hunt.goal: Which move leads to the win?
ls.e_hunt.hint: The piece in the gold ring is the one to move.
ls.e_trap.title: Cut off the escape
ls.e_trap.intro: Here only one move wins. Get there first, so the enemy piece is taken wherever it runs.
ls.e_trap.hint: The piece in the gold ring is the one to move.
